security: Parser-first read-only SQL gate rejects writes, procedures, dangerous functions, and multi-statements.
Queries use native scalar parameter binding and identifiers use engine-specific quoting.
Results enforce row, byte, timeout, and concurrency budgets.
PostgreSQL and MySQL use read-only transactions; Doris, StarRocks, and SQL Server reject effective write privileges.
Private database access requires both OOMOL_CONNECT_ALLOW_PRIVATE_NETWORK and CONNECTION_DATABASE_EGRESS_ALLOWLIST.
ClickHouse rejects redirects so credentials cannot leave the configured database origin.
Credential replacement revokes prior leases and rotates the bounded connection pool.
Audit output is tenant-scoped and redacted, and preserves lease invocationId.
